services.title: Our Services
services.collabText: Contact us and we'll help you bring your project to life.

organicOils.title: Organic Oils
organicOils.desc: Cold-pressed coconut, neem, baobab, and almond oils.
organicOils.detail: Our organic oils like baobab, coconut, neem, and almond are ethically cold-pressed from trusted cooperatives in Africa, Asia, and the Caribbean. Each batch is unrefined and nutrient-rich, perfect for wellness, skincare, or cooking. We prioritize purity, fair trade, and full traceability.

naturalSoaps.title: Natural Soaps
naturalSoaps.desc: African black soap, shea soap, and herbal blends.
naturalSoaps.detail: Our natural soaps include traditional African black soap, shea butter soaps, and special blends with moringa, turmeric, and neem. Made using ancient methods and sustainably harvested ingredients, these soaps provide gentle yet effective cleansing while supporting local artisans.

agroImports.title: Agro & Raw Material Imports
agroImports.desc: Agricultural products, herbs, and eco-packaging from the tropics.
agroImports.detail: We import niche agro-based materials and eco-products like banana leaves, cassava meal, dried herbs, and biodegradable packaging. Our network spans Africa, Asia, and the Caribbean—supporting clean brands, restaurants, and sustainable retailers in the Nordics.

logistics.title: Retail & Logistics Support
logistics.detail: Our logistics service is designed for micro-brands and solo entrepreneurs. We help with warehousing, labeling, Nordic-adapted packaging, and last-mile delivery within Sweden and the EU. Whether you're launching an herbal product or a new snack, our support gets you retail-ready.

ecoSourcing.title: Eco-Sourcing Partnership
ecoSourcing.detail: We believe in ethical, eco-friendly trade. Our eco-sourcing connects you with small-scale farmers using regenerative farming and agroecology. We develop supply chains alongside producers in underrepresented regions, ensuring fair prices, sustainable harvests, and stories that sell.

community.title: Community Engagement
community.detail: Our engagement focuses on youth development, food education, and green entrepreneurship. Through mentoring, workshops, and sports-based programs, we help build bridges between rural talent and urban markets—from local communities in West Africa to integration hubs in Scandinavia.

whatisTropinord.a: TropiNord combines tropical traditions with Nordic quality. We now focus on natural oils and teas from tropical regions, especially Africa.

productsOffered.a: We offer high-quality oils for skin, hair, and cooking, plus teas (herbal, green, black, and special blends), all ethically produced.

organicSourcing.q: Are your products truly organic or natural?
organicSourcing.a: We prioritize cold-pressed, unrefined oils and naturally grown plants. Many come from cooperatives following organic methods.

sourcingAfrica.q: Do your products really come from Africa?
sourcingAfrica.a: Yes, many of our oils and teas are directly imported from cooperatives in West, East, and Southern Africa.

oilUse.q: How do I use your oils? Are they edible?
oilUse.a: Some oils are for skin/hair, others for cooking. Product pages clearly show usage and benefits.

allergens.a: If you're sensitive to nuts, seeds, or herbs—check ingredients. Always do a small skin patch test first.

teaPrep.q: How do I brew the tea?
teaPrep.a: Herbal: 95–100°C for 5–10 min; Green: ~80°C for 2–3 min; Black: 95°C for 3–5 min.

storage.q: How should oils and teas be stored?
storage.a: Store cool and dark. Oils last longer in the fridge. Teas are best stored dry in a tin.

shipsFrom.a: We ship from Sweden and deliver throughout the EU.

shippingPolicy.a: Orders processed within 1–3 days. Sweden: 2–5 days; EU: 5–10+ days. Fees and tracking are shown at checkout.

returnPolicy.a: Unopened items can be returned within 14 days. Opened teas or body care are not returnable unless defective.

payments.a: Card payment via Stripe. In Sweden also Swish and Bankgiro.

contactSupport.a: Via our contact form or info@tropinord.com. Response within 24–48 hours.

wholesale.q: Do you offer wholesale or larger volumes?
wholesale.a: Yes, bulk orders of oils and teas are available upon request—contact sellers@tropinord.com.

shipping.title: Shipping & Returns
shipping.intro: At TropiNord, we are committed to delivering your order quickly and securely. All orders are packed with care, preferably using sustainable materials when possible.
points: Processing Time: Orders are typically processed within 1–3 business days after payment confirmation.
Delivery Time: Within Sweden: 2–5 business days. International: 7–21 business days depending on destination.
Shipping Fees: Calculated at checkout based on weight, size, and delivery address.
Tracking: A tracking link is sent via email once your order has shipped.
Customs & Import Fees: International customers are responsible for any customs duties, VAT, or import costs that may apply.
shipping.returnsIntro: Your satisfaction is important to us. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, we offer returns and exchanges under the following conditions:
returnPoints: Eligibility: Items must be returned unused, in original condition and packaging, within 14 days of delivery.
Non-Returnable Items: For hygiene and safety reasons, personal care items, perishable goods, or custom-made products cannot be returned unless defective.
Return Request: Contact our support team at support@tropinord.com with your order number and reason for return.
Refunds: Approved returns are refunded to the original payment method within 7–10 business days after inspection.
Return Shipping: You are responsible for return shipping unless the item was damaged, defective, or incorrect upon receipt.
shipping.closing: If you have questions or need assistance, don't hesitate to contact us. We're here for you!

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At TropiNord, your privacy is a high priority. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information...

section1.title: 1. What information we collect
section1.personalInfo: Personal information: Name, address, email, phone number, and payment information (used only for transactions).
section1.technicalData: Technical data: IP address, browser type, device identifiers, and visited pages, collected automatically via cookies and analytics tools.
section1.thirdPartyData: Third-party data: Information from payment services and delivery partners for order management.

section2.title: 2. How we use your information
uses: To process and deliver your orders efficiently.
To send order confirmations, delivery updates, or newsletters.
To improve website functions, customer service, and offers.
To fulfill legal or tax requirements according to Swedish and EU law.

section3.title: 3. Data sharing
section3.description: We only share your data with trusted third parties necessary for order processing, such as payment solutions (t.ex. Stripe, Swish, PayPal) and logistics partners. We do not sell or rent your data under any circumstances.

section4.title: 4. Data security
section4.description: We use industry-standard encryption, secure servers, and access controls to protect your personal information. Please note, however, that no digital transmission or storage method is completely secure.

section5.title: 5. Your rights
section5.intro: Under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to:
rights: Request access to your personal data
Request correction of inaccurate or outdated information
Request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
Submit a complaint to a supervisory authority
